title: Right to Information (Regulation of Fee and Cost) Rules, 2012
instrument: RTI (Regulation of Fee and Cost) Rules, 2012
authority: Department of Personnel and Training, Government of India
jurisdiction: Central public authorities (states have their own rules)
summary: Central RTI fee rules: an application fee of ₹10, additional information charges of ₹2 per page (and prescribed rates for disks and inspections), payable via IPO/DD/banker's cheque/cash against receipt/online payment.
text:
Right to Information (Regulation of Fee and Cost) Rules, 2012 — fees and costs for Central public authorities:

Rule 3: a request for information under Section 6(1) of the RTI Act must be accompanied by an application fee of rupees ten (₹10), payable by Indian Postal Order or demand draft or banker's cheque payable to the Accounts Officer of the public authority, or in cash against proper receipt, or through online payment where available (rtionline.gov.in accepts online payment).

Rule 4: further charges — rupees two (₹2) for each page in A4 or smaller; actual charge for larger copies; rupees fifty (₹50) per diskette/floppy; reasonable charges for samples/models; and rupees five (₹5) per hour of inspection after the first hour (free).

Rule 5-6: the PIO must inform the applicant of the further fees and the right to review that decision through appeal; the period between informing and payment is excluded from the response deadline.

State public authorities follow state-specific RTI rules (fee commonly ₹10 with similar copying charges — verify your state's rules).

DEMO KNOWLEDGE BASE ENTRY — condensed summary for demonstration purposes. Verify the current rules at indiacode.nic.in / rtionline.gov.in before relying on it.
